[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]When a capture item creates a project note with `@foo^bar@` or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`@foo:bar@`, a first-level bullet that holds only `^<id>` (or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`:<id>`) moves that open task, with its whole block, from the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]parent note `foo.md` into the new `foo_bar.md`. The task lands in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]draft order, and `:` also makes it Next and links it. Typing `^` or[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`:` after `- ` in such an item opens a Bob Mac Capture move picker [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that lists the parent's open tasks, including tasks without a block[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ID. The preview names every move before submit. The batch is atomic[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and replaces the parent last, so an interrupted write can duplicate[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a task but never lose one.[/#D7D7AF]
